module.purpose: Provides a React hook for verifying email codes through authenticated and unauthenticated platform API endpoints, exposing verification state, errors, reset controls, and completion callbacks.
module.summary: This module wraps two React Query mutations that submit an email and verification code to alternative email-verification endpoints. Both mutations validate the platform success status, update local pending and verification state, invoke the supplied completion callback, and normalize invalid-code and generic API errors. The hook returns mutation triggers alongside state setters and error-reset behavior.
module.businessContext: Supports email ownership and verification flows across authenticated and unauthenticated platform experiences. Failures prevent users from completing verification and may block onboarding or account actions.
